resolve_user.description: Look up user by submitted identifier (email, phone, username). Populates user context for subsequent steps.

outcomes.not_found: No matching user. Flow can branch to registration or show error.

required_factors.description: Evaluate the project's authentication policy against factors already satisfied in this session. Returns which factor is needed next, or signals that the ACR level is met.

domain_requires_sso.description: Check if the user's email domain has an enforced SSO policy.

outcomes.sso_required: Domain mandates SSO — must redirect to IdP.
outcomes.sso_optional: SSO available but not enforced — can fall back to password.

consent_required.description: Check if the OIDC/SAML auth request includes scopes that require explicit user consent.

outcomes.not_required: All scopes previously consented or no consent needed.

session_age_and_acr.description: Evaluate whether the current session is fresh enough and meets the ACR level required for a step-up request.

outcomes.fresh: Session is recent and ACR is sufficient — no re-authentication needed.
outcomes.password_needed: Session is stale — password re-entry required.
outcomes.mfa_needed: Password ACR is met but MFA is required.
outcomes.full_reauth: Session is too old — full re-authentication required.

verify_password.description: Validate the submitted password against the user's stored credential.

outcomes.invalid: Password does not match. Flow can re-render the credential step with an error.

verify_otp.description: Validate the submitted TOTP code against the user's enrolled authenticator.

outcomes.invalid: OTP code is incorrect or expired.

passkey_valid.description: Validate a WebAuthn assertion against the user's registered passkeys.

outcomes.invalid: Assertion failed or key not recognized.

sso_account_exists.description: After SSO callback, check if the external identity maps to an existing user account.

outcomes.existing: SSO identity is linked to an existing user.
outcomes.new: No existing account — user needs to complete registration.

stepup_mfa_required.description: After password re-verification in a step-up flow, check if an additional MFA factor is required to meet the requested ACR.

outcomes.not_required: Password alone meets the required ACR.

create_user_and_session.description: Create a new user from the collected profile data and start an authenticated session.

outcomes.email_taken: A user with this email already exists.

reset_password.description: Replace the user's password with the newly submitted one. Invalidates existing sessions.

outcomes.weak_password: Password does not meet strength requirements.
